```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 5,
  dpi = 144
)
options(knitr.duplicate.label = "allow")

format_number <- function(x, digits = 3L) {
  formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)
}

format_periods <- function(x) {
  if (!length(x)) "None" else paste(x, collapse = ", ")
}
```

```{r multi-analysis-note, results='asis'}
if (length(fits) > 1L) {
  cat(paste0(
    "> **Multiple-analysis note.** Each analysis in this report is estimated ",
    "separately. The report does not pool events or outcomes, and its ",
    "confidence intervals are not adjusted for multiple comparisons.\n\n"
  ))
}
```

```{r analyses, results='asis'}
for (i in seq_along(fits)) {
  child_environment <- new.env(parent = environment())
  child_environment$fit <- fits[[i]]
  child_environment$analysis_name <- names(fits)[i]
  child_environment$multiple_analyses <- length(fits) > 1L
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    section_template,
    envir = child_environment,
    quiet = TRUE
  ), sep = "\n")
}
```

## Reproducibility

```{r reproducibility}
reproducibility <- data.frame(
  Item = c("eventsurvey version", "R version", "Generated"),
  Value = c(
    as.character(utils::packageVersion("eventsurvey")),
    R.version.string,
    format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(reproducibility, align = c("l", "l"))
```
